name: groff
description: The Groff package contains programs for processing and formatting text and images.

installed_descriptions.name: addftinfo
installed_descriptions.description: Reads a troff font file and adds some additional font-metric information that is used by the groff system

installed_descriptions.name: afmtodit
installed_descriptions.description: Creates a font file for use with groff and grops

installed_descriptions.name: chem
installed_descriptions.description: Groff preprocessor for producing chemical structure diagrams

installed_descriptions.name: eqn
installed_descriptions.description: Compiles descriptions of equations embedded within troff input files into commands that are understood by troff

installed_descriptions.name: eqn2graph
installed_descriptions.description: Converts a troff EQN (equation) into a cropped image

installed_descriptions.name: gdiffmk
installed_descriptions.description: Marks differences between groff/nroff/troff files

installed_descriptions.name: glilypond
installed_descriptions.description: Transforms sheet music written in the lilypond language into the groff language

installed_descriptions.name: gperl
installed_descriptions.description: Preprocessor for groff, allowing the insertion of perl code into groff files

installed_descriptions.name: gpinyin
installed_descriptions.description: Preprocessor for groff, allowing the insertion of Pinyin (Mandarin Chinese spelled with the Roman alphabet) into groff files.

installed_descriptions.name: grap2graph
installed_descriptions.description: Converts a grap program file into a cropped bitmap image (grap is an old Unix programming language for creating diagrams)

installed_descriptions.name: grn
installed_descriptions.description: A groff preprocessor for gremlin files

installed_descriptions.name: grodvi
installed_descriptions.description: A driver for groff that produces TeX dvi format output files

installed_descriptions.name: groff
installed_descriptions.description: A front end to the groff document formatting system; normally, it runs the troff program and a post-processor appropriate for the selected device

installed_descriptions.name: groffer
installed_descriptions.description: Displays groff files and man pages on X and tty terminals

installed_descriptions.name: grog
installed_descriptions.description: Reads files and guesses which of the groff options -e, -man, -me, -mm, -ms, -p, -s, and -t are required for printing files, and reports the groff command including those options

installed_descriptions.name: grolbp
installed_descriptions.description: Is a groff driver for Canon CAPSL printers (LBP-4 and LBP-8 series laser printers)

installed_descriptions.name: grolj4
installed_descriptions.description: Is a driver for groff that produces output in PCL5 format suitable for an HP LaserJet 4 printer

installed_descriptions.name: gropdf
installed_descriptions.description: Translates the output of GNU troff to PDF

installed_descriptions.name: grops
installed_descriptions.description: Translates the output of GNU troff to PostScript

installed_descriptions.name: grotty
installed_descriptions.description: Translates the output of GNU troff into a form suitable for typewriter-like devices

installed_descriptions.name: hpftodit
installed_descriptions.description: Creates a font file for use with groff -Tlj4 from an HP-tagged font metric file

installed_descriptions.name: indxbib
installed_descriptions.description: Creates an inverted index for the bibliographic databases with a specified file for use with refer, lookbib, and lkbib

installed_descriptions.name: lkbib
installed_descriptions.description: Searches bibliographic databases for references that contain specified keys and reports any references found

installed_descriptions.name: lookbib
installed_descriptions.description: Prints a prompt on the standard error (unless the standard input is not a terminal), reads a line containing a set of keywords from the standard input, searches the bibliographic databases in a specified file for references containing those keywords, prints any references found on the standard output, and repeats this process until the end of input

installed_descriptions.name: mmroff
installed_descriptions.description: A simple preprocessor for groff

installed_descriptions.name: neqn
installed_descriptions.description: Formats equations for American Standard Code for Information Interchange (ASCII) output

installed_descriptions.name: nroff
installed_descriptions.description: A script that emulates the nroff command using groff

installed_descriptions.name: pdfmom
installed_descriptions.description: Is a wrapper around groff that facilitates the production of PDF documents from files formatted with the mom macros.

installed_descriptions.name: pdfroff
installed_descriptions.description: Creates pdf documents using groff

installed_descriptions.name: pfbtops
installed_descriptions.description: Translates a PostScript font in .pfb format to ASCII

installed_descriptions.name: pic
installed_descriptions.description: Compiles descriptions of pictures embedded within troff or TeX input files into commands understood by TeX or troff

installed_descriptions.name: pic2graph
installed_descriptions.description: Converts a PIC diagram into a cropped image

installed_descriptions.name: post-grohtml
installed_descriptions.description: Translates the output of GNU troff to HTML

installed_descriptions.name: preconv
installed_descriptions.description: Converts encoding of input files to something GNU troff understands

installed_descriptions.name: pre-grohtml
installed_descriptions.description: Translates the output of GNU troff to HTML

installed_descriptions.name: refer
installed_descriptions.description: Copies the contents of a file to the standard output, except that lines between .[ and .] are interpreted as citations, and lines between .R1 and .R2 are interpreted as commands for how citations are to be processed

installed_descriptions.name: roff2dvi
installed_descriptions.description: Transforms roff files into DVI format

installed_descriptions.name: roff2html
installed_descriptions.description: Transforms roff files into HTML format

installed_descriptions.name: roff2pdf
installed_descriptions.description: Transforms roff files into PDFs

installed_descriptions.name: roff2ps
installed_descriptions.description: Transforms roff files into ps files

installed_descriptions.name: roff2text
installed_descriptions.description: Transforms roff files into text files

installed_descriptions.name: roff2x
installed_descriptions.description: Transforms roff files into other formats

installed_descriptions.name: soelim
installed_descriptions.description: Reads files and replaces lines of the form .so file by the contents of the mentioned file

installed_descriptions.name: tbl
installed_descriptions.description: Compiles descriptions of tables embedded within troff input files into commands that are understood by troff

installed_descriptions.name: tfmtodit
installed_descriptions.description: Creates a font file for use with groff -Tdvi

installed_descriptions.name: troff
installed_descriptions.description: Is highly compatible with Unix troff; it should usually be invoked using the groff command, which will also run preprocessors and post-processors in the appropriate order and with the appropriate options
